title: OpenAI’s Hugging Face breach has reignited the debate over alignment and control
summary: Last week, an unreleased model built by OpenAI breached Hugging Face’s systems during internal testing, and a lot of theoretical research suddenly became very practical. For alignment-focused researchers, OpenAI’s response isn’t good enough.
